subject.title: fix: queued voice replies are lost when the delivery queue retries them

question: Should this PR merge with conservatively unbounded orphan retention, or must queue-owned media receive a bounded and observable cleanup policy first?
rationale: The patch deliberately prioritizes never deleting referenced media over bounding private-media storage; repository behavior and tests cannot decide that operator-impact and retention trade-off without maintainer intent.

options.title: Bound orphan retention first
options.body: Add a reference-safe cleanup or quarantine mechanism plus diagnostics that bounds unreferenced artifacts without deleting media still named by pending rows.

options.title: Accept conservative retention
options.body: Merge the current policy while explicitly accepting possible indefinite orphan storage and documenting an operator-visible inspection and cleanup path.

recommendation.title: Bound orphan retention first
recommendation.body: Add a reference-safe cleanup or quarantine mechanism plus diagnostics that bounds unreferenced artifacts without deleting media still named by pending rows.

likelyOwner.reason: The current-main history shows the strongest ownership across outbound durability, media capability plumbing, and active-delivery lifecycle behavior.
